candidates.original_title: BET bromodomain inhibition as a therapeutic strategy to target c-Myc
candidates.description: Treatment of MM.1S cells with (+)-JQ1 reduces MYC expression at 1 hour compared with baseline.
candidates.citation_sentence: This experiment is similar to what was reported in Figure 3B (Delmore et al., 2011) and assesses the levels of MYC by quantitative reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR) in a human MM cell line stabling expressing luciferase (MM.1S-luc) (Mitsiades et al., 2004).
candidates.notes: The replication found a statistically significant reduction in MYC expression at 1 hour in the expected direction. [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: BET bromodomain inhibition as a therapeutic strategy to target c-Myc
candidates.description: Treatment with (+)-JQ1 prolongs overall survival in mice bearing bioluminescent MM.1S tumors compared with vehicle control.
candidates.citation_sentence: In order to test the effectiveness of (+)-JQ1 as a therapeutic strategy to target c-Myc, we sought to replicate experiments similar to what was reported in Figure 7C–E (Delmore et al., 2011).
candidates.notes: Survival was longer with (+)-JQ1, but the Bonferroni-corrected p-value exceeded the preregistered significance threshold. [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]
